metadata.description: autistic.computer plugins for Claude Code: crew runs Codex and Gemini as background workers, okf keeps Open Knowledge Format knowledge bundles, craft holds the house rules for code and for Rust, narrow turns a half-formed idea into a settled one.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Run Codex and Gemini as background workers from Claude Code over MCP, with their findings pushed into your session as they land.

plugins.name: okf
plugins.description: Author, maintain, and read Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.3) knowledge bundles: markdown concepts with YAML frontmatter, and a CLI that scaffolds, indexes, validates, migrates, searches and renders them.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: House engineering rules for writing, refactoring and reviewing code: craft for any language, and rust for Rust on top of it.

plugins.name: narrow
plugins.description: An idea-forming conversation: go wide with a numbered list of angles, pick which to narrow into, and repeat for at most three rounds, with web research every round and a preferred approach at the end.
